title: Director, Data Center Critical Infrastructure Execution
description:
Lead a high-impact execution team responsible for unblocking critical power and cooling constraints that affect AI data-center capacity delivery. This role owns the operating model, priorities, and cross-functional execution required to move complex infrastructure issues from identification through resolution.
  
The Director will lead a small team of senior data-center engineers and work across design, construction, commissioning, operations, supply chain, vendors, and capacity-delivery organizations.

  

* Lead the critical-infrastructure execution team and set priorities based on capacity, schedule, cost, operational risk, and customer impact.
* Drive resolution of complex power and cooling blockers across live and new-build data centers.
* Establish a rigorous operating cadence for issue intake, root-cause analysis, decision-making, escalation, and closure.
* Partner with facilities, construction, commissioning, design engineering, network, compute, procurement, and external vendors to recover schedules and deliver capacity.
* Review major site risks, including electrical distribution, generator and UPS capacity, mechanical cooling capacity, controls, commissioning readiness, and turnover dependencies.
* Develop clear executive updates that state the issue, business impact, decision required, owner, and recovery plan.
* Build repeatable playbooks, lessons learned, and metrics to prevent repeat issues across the data-center fleet.
* Manage and develop IC4 engineers; create a culture of technical rigor, ownership, urgency, and safe execution.
* Influence senior stakeholders without direct authority and resolve competing priorities across teams.

**Qualifications**

* 12+ years of experience in mission-critical facilities, data-center engineering, construction, commissioning, or operations.
* Deep understanding of critical power and cooling systems, including utility infrastructure, generators, switchgear, UPS, PDUs, busway, chillers, cooling towers, pumps, CRAHs/
